correctness.rationale: Density c=1+alpha(1-2u)(1-2v)+beta(1-3u^2)(1-3v^2) integrates to rho=alpha/3+3beta/4. At t=(9-sqrt(57))/24 positivity of c(t,1) gives global rho<=1/[3(1-2t)]=(sqrt57-3)/12. At alpha*=-3+7sqrt57/19 and beta*=1-sqrt57/19, c(u,1)=6beta*(u-t)^2, the lower v=0 edge is concave with positive endpoints, and for min(u,v)<=1/sqrt3 the density is concave in the other variable with nonnegative endpoints. Both u,v>1/sqrt3 give c>=1+alpha*>0. Equality forces an interior tangency on v=1, hence derivative=0 and unique parameter pair. Independently reproduced radical/tangency identities with SymPy; finite grids do not prove global positivity.
